Multiple Films Compete at Box Office, Collections Vary

Several films, including 'Minions & Monsters', 'Alpha', 'Cocktail 2', and 'Welcome To The Jungle', have reported their box office collections. While 'Minions & Monsters' achieved a significant global opening weekend, 'Alpha' saw a drop after its initial weekend and struggled to reach certain financial milestones. 'Welcome To The Jungle' and 'Cocktail 2' also reported varying collection figures, with some indicating strong Saturday performances.
